person_note: The book uses rotating third-person focalization across characters and timelines, not alternating grammatical persons. The quote set repeatedly shows external narration of Judy, Louise, Tracy, Alice, Carl, and others, while authorized excerpts independently sustain the same third-person method in Tracy and Carl sections. First-person forms in the quotes occur in dialogue, direct thought, gnomic language, or an attributed paratextual excerpt and therefore do not constitute first-person base sections. The principal limitation is that each authorized excerpt covers a named section rather than the entire novel, but their agreement with the broad quote sample and the explicit whole-book structural description supports THIRD at high confidence.
